top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and the identification of its active form (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is a mature, independently validated discovery with large randomized outcome-trial evidence and transformative clinical consequences for type 2 diabetes and obesity. The physiology-focused citation keeps the award on the discovery rather than a drug class. The attribution gaps (Mojsov versus Habener priority, Knudsen excluded by the three-name cap) are real but do not outweigh the achievement, so awarding is preferable to no award.
